column7: Fingerprints the whole declared account descriptor into the binding token a stored result is judged by; a weaker digest would let output made under one descriptor be served as another's (MIK-8407)
Decides which direct-route backends record and judge the forwarded credential; a wrong answer serves one credential's stored output to another (MIK-8440)
Collects the bindings a task settles or parks with; a missing binding makes a row serve under any later account (MIK-8407)
Merges dispatched targets into a row before its version is raised; a dropped target would let its output be re-authorized against nothing (#2450, shared by add_targets and settle)
